integrity: Mathematical argument and bounded verification supplied, with novelty restricted to the quantitative failure census and minimum-defect matching rigidity.
scientific_limitations: Defect theorem concerns proper colourings of square rook graphs with palette budget n+1. Classical AVD edge-colouring already gives the chromatic threshold; no new priority is claimed for it. The complete 2026 motivating preprint was not accessible, and further bibliographic overlap is possible. Computational checks are finite and there is no independent audit.
title: A sharp defect identity and matching rigidity at the rook-graph colouring threshold
